reuse.why: Extends the existing getExpectedScheduleAmount helper, but recomputes the 7.5% rounded tolerance inline instead of calling the existing getApproxNumberThreshold from shared/rules.

duplication.why: Math.round(Math.abs(amount) * 0.075) duplicates getApproxNumberThreshold, so matching and planning tolerances can drift apart.

placement.why: The rule sits in the shared amount helper in shared/schedules.ts, but every caller must now thread the op through a third positional argument after an unrelated rounding flag.

scope.why: Mostly focused; making APIScheduleEntity.expectedAmount optional is an unrelated type edit.

maintainability.why: Opt-in positional amountOp after a dummy 'midpoint' argument is easy to forget, and getScheduledAmount (used by client Balance and schedule lists) does not pass it.

bypasses_abstraction.where: shared/schedules.ts getExpectedScheduleAmount recomputes the approx tolerance instead of using getApproxNumberThreshold in shared/rules.ts.

disguised_duplication.where: The tolerance formula is a direct inline copy of getApproxNumberThreshold, not reshaped.

one_place.where: The worst-case rule lives in getExpectedScheduleAmount, but it only applies when each caller passes amountOp; getScheduledAmount (client Balance/schedule views) does not, and the tolerance is a second copy of getApproxNumberThreshold.
